HEADER.TITLE: Triage Flows
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Greet people with a menu when they start a conversation, then send them to the right team based on what they pick.

EMPTY_STATE.TITLE: No triage flows yet
EMPTY_STATE.SUBTITLE: Build a menu for one of your inboxes to sort incoming conversations before an agent ever sees them.

INDEX.WARNING_COUNT: {count} thing to fix | {count} things to fix

WARNINGS.UNREACHABLE_STEP: Nothing leads to the question "{stepId}", so it is never asked.
WARNINGS.MISSING_TEAM: A route still sends conversations to team {teamId}, which was deleted.

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not create the flow. Check the highlighted questions and try again.
Could not save the flow. Check the highlighted questions and try again.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete triage flow
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Conversations in this inbox will stop being triaged and will reach your team the way they did before. This cannot be undone.

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not delete the flow. Please try again.

CLONE.TITLE: Copy flow to another inbox
CLONE.DESCRIPTION: Every question, option and routing rule is copied over. The copy starts out turned off, so you can review it before it greets anyone.
CLONE.EMPTY_INBOXES: Every inbox already has a flow.

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not copy the flow. The target channel may not support these options.

INBOX.LABEL: Inbox
INBOX.EMPTY_STATE: Every inbox already has a flow.
INBOX.HINT: Inboxes that already have a flow are not listed.
INBOX.LOCKED_HINT: The inbox cannot be changed after the flow is created. Copy the flow instead.

ENABLED.LABEL: Enabled
ENABLED.DESCRIPTION: Turn the flow off to stop it without deleting it.

SHADOW.LABEL: Shadow
SHADOW.DESCRIPTION: The flow runs silently and records what it would have done. Nothing is sent to the contact.

LIVE.LABEL: Live
LIVE.DESCRIPTION: The flow greets contacts and routes their conversations for real.

FORM.LEAVE_CONFIRM: You have unsaved changes to this flow. Leave anyway and lose them?

NO_MATCH.TITLE: When the reply doesn't match
NO_MATCH.DESCRIPTION: What happens when someone answers with something that isn't on the menu.

MESSAGE.LABEL: Reply with
MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please pick one of the options.

TIMEOUT.TITLE: When the contact goes quiet
TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: What happens when nobody replies to the menu.

STEPS.TITLE: Questions
STEPS.DESCRIPTION: Each question shows the contact a short message and a list of options to pick from.

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Delete this question?
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Its {options} option(s) and their routing are removed, and {parents} question(s) pointing at it lose their destination. This cannot be undone.

PROMPT.LABEL: Message
PROMPT.PLACEHOLDER: How can we help you today?

WARNINGS.UNREACHABLE: No option leads to this question, so nobody is ever asked it.

OPTIONS.LABEL: Options
OPTIONS.EMPTY: Add at least one option so the contact has something to pick.
OPTIONS.LIMIT_REACHED: This channel shows at most {max} options.
OPTIONS.LIST_SWITCH: One more option switches this channel from buttons to a list, where titles can be {max} characters.

TEAM.LABEL: Assign to team
TEAM.EMPTY_STATE: No teams yet. Create one in Settings.
TEAM.MISSING: This team was deleted. Pick another one before saving.

LABELS.LABEL: Add labels
LABELS.EMPTY_STATE: No labels yet. Create one in Settings.

MESSAGE.LABEL: Closing message
MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Got it, our team will be with you shortly.
MESSAGE.SILENT: Leave this empty and the contact gets no reply after picking this option — only silence.

PREVIEW.EMPTY: Add a question to see what the contact receives.
PREVIEW.NO_OPTIONS: This question has no options yet.
PREVIEW.TOO_MANY_OPTIONS: This channel shows at most {max} options, {count} configured.
